title: The populist legacy
goal: Weigh the legacy of populist governments, with results that people praise and results that people criticise, using contrast connectors.
grammar: Contrast connectors: sin embargo, no obstante, aunque

items: I can say what these governments left to the workers.
I can describe how they supported industry.
I can explain what critics say about the concentration of power.
I can say how the governments of Cárdenas, Vargas and Perón ended.
I can join contrasting ideas with sin embargo, no obstante and aunque.
